description: CsNa₃P₄(HO₂)₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.68 Å) Na-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-60°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.64 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Cs, one Na, and two equivalent H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two Na, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs and two equivalent P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Cs and two equivalent P atoms.
